import math
# Build on Z, then orient the shaft along positive Y.
head = cq.Solid.makeCone(25,14,22)
collar = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(14,3,cq.Vector(0,0,22))
shaft = cq.Workplane("XY",origin=(0,0,25)).circle(13).extrude(32)
for i in range(16):
    a=2*math.pi*i/16
    pts=[]
    for r,t in [(11.6,0),(15,-0.065),(15,0.065)]:
        pts.append((r*math.cos(a+t),r*math.sin(a+t)))
    cut = cq.Workplane("XY",origin=(0,0,25)).polyline(pts).close().extrude(32)
    shaft=shaft.cut(cut)
part=cq.Workplane("XY").newObject([head]).union(collar).union(shaft)
part=part.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").circle(10).extrude(20))
result=part.rotate((0,0,0),(1,0,0),-90)
